triggers.label: Manually (Run button or API)
triggers.description: Start from the Run button or POST /flows/<id>/run with inputs.

triggers.label: ITSM ticket event
triggers.description: A ticket is created or updated in ServiceNow, Jira, Freshservice, BMC Helix… (sent to VireoNet's ITSM webhook).

triggers.label: Webhook (any JSON)
triggers.description: Any system POSTs JSON to /webhooks/flows/<flow id> with the flow's token.

triggers.label: Schedule
triggers.description: Run on a cron schedule (UTC), e.g. 0 2 * * 1-5, or every N minutes.

fields.name: cron
fields.label: Cron (UTC)
fields.help: minute hour day month weekday

triggers.label: Kafka message (optional)
triggers.description: A message on a Kafka topic (needs VIREONET_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP). JSON values are parsed.

triggers.label: VireoNet event
triggers.description: Something happened in VireoNet: a change finished, drift was found, log anomalies were detected.

triggers.label: NetBox change
triggers.description: A device, interface, IP, VLAN… is created, updated or deleted in NetBox (NetBox webhook → /webhooks/flows/source/netbox).

triggers.label: Zabbix problem
triggers.description: A Zabbix trigger fires, recovers or is updated (webhook media type → /webhooks/flows/source/zabbix).

triggers.label: Prometheus alert
triggers.description: Alertmanager sends a firing or resolved alert (webhook receiver → /webhooks/flows/source/prometheus).

triggers.label: LibreNMS alert
triggers.description: A LibreNMS alert rule fires or recovers (API transport → /webhooks/flows/source/librenms).

triggers.label: PRTG sensor
triggers.description: A PRTG sensor goes down or up (HTTP action → /webhooks/flows/source/prtg).

triggers.label: SolarWinds alert
triggers.description: A SolarWinds Orion alert triggers or resets (web request action → /webhooks/flows/source/solarwinds).

triggers.label: Git push / merge
triggers.description: A push or merge in GitHub, GitLab or Gitea (repo webhook → /webhooks/flows/source/git).

triggers.label: AWX job finished
triggers.description: An AWX / Ansible Automation Platform job finishes (notification webhook → /webhooks/flows/source/awx).

examples.name: OS upgrade via controller (any vendor)
examples.description: A ticket 'OS UPGRADE <device> to <version>' in Implement: the device's controller (Catalyst Center, CloudVision, Mist, Apstra, FortiManager, Panorama, NSP, XIQ, Meraki, Aruba Central — picked automatically from the NetBox platform) upgrades it; verify; close the ticket. On failure, activate the previous version and report on the ticket.

examples.name: OS upgrade from an ITSM ticket (boot image via change pipeline)
examples.description: A ticket whose summary is 'OS UPGRADE <device> to <version>' reaches Implement: check the current version, ask for approval on P1/P2, set the boot image through the full change pipeline (locks, backup, dry-run, checks, Git rollback), verify, and close the ticket — or report the failure on the ticket.

examples.name: Zabbix link down: triage
examples.description: A high-severity Zabbix 'Link down on <interface>' problem: look at the interface a few times, then notify with the result.

examples.name: NetBox device activated: onboarding checks
examples.description: A device's status changes to active in NetBox: read it, run read-only checks, post the result.

examples.name: Nightly VLAN audit
examples.description: Every night: check that VLAN 100 exists on every leaf; collect the ones without it and notify.

examples.name: API call and custom script (learning example)
examples.description: Manual run with inputs: call a REST API, transform the answer in Python, branch on the result.
